task_instance: Run the skill's core read flow against the Auto Ontology semantic layer: check_readiness, search_terms, check_answerable, then ask_question for a grounded count (e.g. 'How many orders shipped last week?'), returning the generated SQL, rows, and a validated claim-bearing answer.
blocker_detail: The skill's entire deliverable depends on a prerequisite it states explicitly: a running Auto Ontology deployment plus an authenticated MCP or REST client. No such deployment exists or is reachable in this runtime, and there is no auto-ontology-mcp command installed. Standing one up is out of scope for this skill (it hands bring-up to a separate setup skill that is not present) and would require account-bound secrets the runtime neither provides nor permits me to use: an Auto Ontology API token / browser session / OAuth or SSO JWT for the authenticated gateway, and NVIDIA NIM endpoint+API-key triplets (NVIDIA_API_KEY etc.) for the chat, embedding, reranking, and NL-to-SQL models the service calls. The skill also forbids fabricating the service or its answers, and MCP/connector tools are forbidden by the safety rules, so there is no permitted path to exercise the core query-and-validate flow.
